name: neurotoxicity
description: Toxicity that causes injury to the central or peripheral nervous system or damages its function. This can include stroke, multiple sclerosis, encephalopathy, dementia, Alzheimer's disease, amnesia, dyskinesia, Parkinson's disease, tremor, convulsions and Guillain Barre syndrome.
